ios.desc:
The easiest way to automate anything. Connect 1000+ apps and devices, and let AI handle the busywork.

IFTTT (If This Then That) is the no-code automation platform trusted by over 32 million people, from smart home enthusiasts to creators to small business owners. Pick your apps, describe what you want, and IFTTT does the rest. Your automations run quietly in the background so you can get hours back every week.

Build and run powerful automations for free. Even advanced Applets with queries, filters, delays, and multiple actions are easy to create and free to try.

New AI tools
- Watch a Page: Monitor any website and get alerted the moment something changes. Track price drops, restocks, new job posts, listings, and more.
- AI Agent Action: One flexible action that works across your connected apps. Just tell it what to do in plain language.
- IFTTT AI: Summarize emails, articles, and feeds, draft social posts, and create content automatically.

Ideas to get you started
- Get a notification when a product page drops in price or comes back in stock
- Summarize new emails or articles and send the highlights to Slack
- Write once, then cross-post to multiple social networks
- Connect and control every part of your smart home
- Use IFTTT Location to trigger work and smart home automations
- Automate even more apps with IFTTT Webhooks

Built for iPhone and iOS
Automate on the go with location-based triggers, customizable notifications, and multiple widget types.

Top iOS and apps
Apple Calendar, Contacts, Health, Photos, Reading List, Reminders, Shortcuts

IFTTT AI services
AI Agent, AI Content Creator, AI Prompt, AI Social Creator, AI Summarizer, AI YouTube Assistant and more

android.desc:
The easiest way to automate anything. Connect 1000+ apps and devices, and let IFTTT.ai handle the busywork.



Describe what you want to automate and IFTTT does the rest. Build anything from a simple two-step workflow to advanced Applets with queries, filters, delays, and multiple actions, all free to start. 



IFTTT (If This Then That) is the no-code automation platform trusted by over 32 million people, from smart home enthusiasts to creators to small business owners. No coding and no complicated setups. Your automations run quietly in the background so you can get hours back every week.





Built for Android

Automate on the go with location-based triggers, custom notifications, and home screen widgets. Available for Android phones and Wear OS.



New AI features

Watch a page: Monitor any website and get alerted the moment something changes. Track price drops, restocks, new job posts, listings, announcements, and more.

AI Agent action: One flexible action that works across your connected apps. Just tell IFTTT what to do in plain language.

Get a notification when a product page drops in price or comes back in stock.

Summarize new emails or RSS articles and send the highlights to Slack or Telegram.

Cross-post content to multiple social networks at once.

Connect and control every part of your smart home.

Control key Android features like Bluetooth, WiFi, ringtone volume, and battery.

Use Webhooks to build custom integrations.
